preMergeDevelopmentWaiver.authority: The user-authorized throughput correction explicitly makes satisfied non-privileged IC-M00-G-DEV sufficient for IC-M01 product implementation while retaining P01 integration and SATISFIED status behind release assurance.
preMergeDevelopmentWaiver.scope: Development and review only on top of exact admitted P01 tree a8cdcbdeb49a897946dd520981d59d9a1a3813b6; it does not waive P01 release assurance, protected integration, post-merge evidence, or any P02/P03/P04 acceptance criterion.
preMergeDevelopmentWaiver.integrationReconciliation: Before any IC-M01 protected integration, fetch the actual integrated P01 revision and mechanically compare its P01 tree to admitted base a8cdcbdeb49a897946dd520981d59d9a1a3813b6. Rebase or replay IC-M01 onto that exact integrated base and refreeze the candidate identity. Any semantic P01 difference invalidates cumulative integration evidence and requires a dependency reconciliation before one authoritative IC-M01 route; unchanged product commits and package evidence remain reusable.
preMergeDevelopmentWaiver.failureEffect: A differing integrated P01 base blocks IC-M01 integration but does not discard isolated product work or authorize a merge.

outcome: Deliver the Claude Code and Codex subscription runtime, encrypted local persistence, and one durable InterviewSession authority together on top of the development-admitted P01 candidate.

requirements.title: Subscription-only persistent agent runtime
ownedBehavior: accept only claude-code and codex subscription providers and remove legacy API-key, credit, entitlement, quota, and paywall answer surfaces
pin and validate supported Claude Code and Codex CLI protocol versions and fail explicitly on unsupported capabilities
resume caller-owned Claude sessions and Codex threads across driver or child-process restart while persisting no opaque provider conversation identifier
never fall back to an unselected provider and snapshot provider, model, effort, and response mode without silent substitution
normalize streaming, typed payload, usage, compaction, stop, completion, and sanitized error events
use absolute executables, shell false, scrubbed provider-secret environment, bounded output and time, and graceful then forced cancellation
migrate legacy config through atomic idempotent owner-only M-01 without rewriting secrets or adding a conversation field
complete provider-only onboarding without capture or audio permission

requirements.title: Encrypted local persistence foundation
ownedBehavior: protect one random installation key through Electron safeStorage and macOS Keychain and reopen records after restart
store versioned AES-256-GCM record and blob envelopes with unique nonces and authenticated type, version, and ID metadata
persist no plaintext sensitive records, blobs, indexes, thumbnails, caches, temp data, or keys
provide atomic prior-or-new writes under interruption or disk exhaustion with isolated non-destructive corruption handling
enforce owner-only canonical paths and reject symlink or out-of-root access
journal, verify, resume, and safely roll back M-02 and M-03 without deleting the only readable copy
reject raw-audio persistence and surface typed Keychain or record recovery

requirements.title: Interview session domain and orchestrator
ownedBehavior: make one deterministic exhaustively typed InterviewSession reducer the sole session authority and reject stale, duplicate, cross-session, invalid, and out-of-order events
snapshot mode, provider, model, response mode, language, and applicable context from Start until Reset
seed applicable context once, send ordered deltas, and exclude dossier and opportunity bytes from Coding
stage, exclude, submit, and deduplicate transcript and screenshot evidence with screenshot authority on conflict
stream stable typed response sections and preserve complete or partial output through cancel and Continue unfinished
route curated mode actions, typed chat, and compact clarification through one provider conversation
answer best effort without confidence gates and apply correction deltas only to affected sections
seal Reset and crash recovery through P03 encrypted M-04 snapshots, keeping the opaque provider identifier encrypted and requiring explicit Resume with capture off

key lifecycle, nonce uniqueness, authenticated metadata, plaintext byte scans, atomicity, path safety, corruption, wrong-user or locked-Keychain recovery, and migration rollback
session property corpus, cross-session denial, context exclusion, evidence deduplication, response routing, cancellation, Reset race, and encrypted opaque-ID recovery

rollback.identityBinding: All code, configuration, storage, session, migration, and rollback evidence is bound to the final reviewed exact candidate SHA and its reconciled integrated-P01 base. A remediation creates a new candidate identity and requires the one exact delta verdict before authoritative verification.
rollback.code: Return the IC-M01 branch from its final exact candidate to reconciled admitted base revision a8cdcbdeb49a897946dd520981d59d9a1a3813b6 or the mechanically equivalent eventual integrated P01 revision; PR 155 and the user worktree remain unchanged.
rollback.configuration: M-01 restores the owner-only redacted legacy backup only after explicit user choice and never restores removed secrets automatically.
rollback.storage: M-02 and M-03 retain the prior readable source in explicit rollback quarantine until decrypt-before-delete and replay acceptance; no new plaintext is written.
rollback.session: M-04 retains the encrypted v1 record and rejects forward versions without lossy conversion.
rollback.external: No deployment, signing, live provider, administrator, Keychain mutation, or public release action is part of milestone implementation.
